effective_date_evidence.quote: notified in the Gazette of India vide GSR No.457 dated 05th December, 2017

evidence.quote: in supersession of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (Multi-Tasking Staff) Recruitment Rules, 2011

relationships.scope: The 2017 Multi-Tasking Staff recruitment rules replace the 2011 rules, except as respects things done or omitted before the supersession. Commencement is on publication in the Gazette (GSR 457, 5 December 2017).

evidence.quote: in supersession of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation, Section Supervisor, Recruitment Regulations, 2017

relationships.scope: The 2019 Section Supervisor recruitment rules replace the 2017 regulations, except as respects things done or omitted before the supersession. Published in the Gazette on 31 January 2019.
The August 2019 model-calendar circular forwards the DoPT OM of 8 May 2017 and refers to the November 2017 Head Office circular on DPC procedure; it does not state that it replaces it.
The December 2023 circular reminds offices to follow the April 2022 model calendar; it sets no new timelines.
A further reminder, referring to the 1 December 2023 circular and the April 2022 calendar; no new timelines.

limitations: This concerns EPFO staff recruitment rules and regulations, DPC procedure and promotion guidelines, and the MACP/NFU/NFSG schemes as applied in EPFO. It is not about EPF members.

15 documents are drafts placed on the website for stakeholder comments (30 or 15 days). They are consultation-only: they appear in the inventory but are never treated as notified rules, and the notified versions of most of them (APFC, EO/AO, Programmer, LDC/SSA, STO, IS technical cadres, JSA/SSA/SO, ASO, Commissioners' cadre, Field office cadre, Stenographer) are not in this collection.

Only two supersessions are expressly stated and both predecessors are in the set: Multi-Tasking Staff rules 2017 over 2011, and Section Supervisor rules 2019 over the 2017 regulations. The 2011 MTS rules repeal earlier 2004 and 2006 rules, and the 2017 Director (OL) and 2018 Commissioner-cadre documents amend principal rules (2008, 2011) that are not in this collection. Missing predecessors are not inferred.

Rules come into force on publication in the Gazette. An effective date is recorded only where the circular states the Gazette notification or publication date (PPS, MTS 2017, Section Supervisor 2017 and 2019). For other notified rules the Gazette date is not stated in the checked text and is left unset.

Most MACP, NFU and DPC circulars forward Department of Personnel and Training or Department of Expenditure OMs; those OMs govern. The model-calendar circulars of 2022 and 2023 are reminders and set no new timelines.

Individual MACP grants, region-wise lists, annual "conducting DPC" notices, direct-recruitment appointment orders and examination notices are not covered, nor is the 2025 Staff Regulations framework mentioned in a 2026 circular. The Recruitment Rules for RPFC Grade-II (Amendment) 2011 circular is not in the issuer mirror and is not included.
PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 3 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths that day; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR.
